16474               	; 	' THE COLOUR TABLE, 472 bytes of the same value ($B4 = black ink on dark blue).
16475               	; 	'
16476               	; 	' Loaded with DEFINE COLOR 32,59,font_col, which is ONE synchronous call that
16477               	; 	' writes all three screen thirds (define_color always does the LDIRVM3 triple
16478               	; 	' copy). It replaced a VPOKE loop that wrote this one value 1,416 times paced by
16479               	; 	' 24 WAITs -- the largest scripted delay in the boot, and the reason the title
16480               	; 	' screen used to fill in visibly rather than appearing at once.
16481               	; 	'
16482               	; 	' EIGHT BYTES PER CHARACTER, not one. Supply fewer and DEFINE COLOR reads
16483               	; 	' whatever follows in ROM as colour data, with no error at build or run time.

17149               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
17150               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
17151               	; 	'
17152               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
17153               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
17154               	; 	' being small sprites.
17155               	; 	'
17156               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
17157               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
17158               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
17159               	; 	'
17160               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
17161               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
17162               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
17163               	;
17164               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/two merged run bodies/two FREE slots/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite, and standing is run frame 1. Patterns 0..68

18396               	; 	INCLUDE "store.bas"
18397               	; 	' Keystone Kapers store -- GENERATED by assets/genstore.py. Do not edit.
18398               	; 	'
18399               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
18400               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
18401               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
18402               	; 	'
18403               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
18404               	; 	' blit is
18405               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
18406               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
18407               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
18408               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
18409               	; 	'
18410               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
18411               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
18412               	; 	'
18413               	; 	' template ids:
18414               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
18415               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
18416               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
18417               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
18418               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
18419               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
18420               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
18421               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
18422               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
18423               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
18424               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
18425               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
18426               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
18427               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
18428               	; 	'   14 T_END_E
18429               	;
18430               	; stor_tpl:	' 15 templates x 160 bytes
18431               cvb_STOR_TPL

19046               	;
19047               	; 	' THE SKYLINE'S LAST BAND WITHOUT ITS YELLOW, high nibble ink, low nibble
19048               	; 	' paper, one byte a scan line -- the same shape genart emits into
19049               	; 	' store_col. SKY2 is white-on-9 throughout instead of turning to paper 10
19050               	; 	' at row 4; BLDGL holds its blue one row longer and then meets its own
19051               	; 	' grey wall. Both are the generated bytes with 10 replaced by 9 and
19052               	; 	' nothing else changed. See setup_rest.
19053               	; #if NES
19054               	; nes_sky2c:
19055               	; 	DATA BYTE $F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9
19056               	; nes_bldlc:
19057               	; 	DATA BYTE $B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$BE,$BE,$BE
19058               	; #endif
19059               	;
19060               	; 	' THE IN-GAME FONT'S COLOUR, one byte a scan line and eight a character for
19061               	; 	' all 59 of them. $B4 is light yellow on dark blue -- ink index 3, paper index 1 --
19062               	; 	' and which colours those are is then the attribute table's business, per
19063               	; 	' region: dark blue behind the HUD, the store's green behind a message box.
19064               	; 	'
19065               	; 	' 472 bytes of one repeated value. That reads like waste and is the cheap
19066               	; 	' option: ROM is three budgets here and this is not the scarce one, while
19067               	; 	' the alternative is a second font (impossible -- only eleven free codes)
19068               	; 	' or a new uploader parameter (no RAM -- two bytes left).

19070               	; nes_fcol:
